name: Ramzinex (رمزینکس)

limitations.detail: Private API requires rotating bearer token (regenerated every 10 min from API key) sent via headers 'Authorization2: Bearer {token}' and 'x-api-key' (per official php-sdk) â not expressible in template; public endpoints unauthenticated.

Docs portal renders via JS (unreadable); endpoint paths taken from official Ramzinex Postman collection and ramzinex/php-sdk sample output; only url_name, buy, sell, pair_id, base/quote_currency_symbol verified as response fields.
Markets identified by numeric pair_id (e.g. 272), not symbol strings â adapter must resolve symbol->pair_id via markets endpoint; price mapped to best-ask 'sell' since last-price field unverified.
Full supported candle-resolution list not documented; using UDF-standard values (15/60/240/1D); candles use unix seconds for from/to.
Order placement/cancel endpoints, params and response shapes not present in provided corpus â only public market data configured.
Leverage products (easy/floating leverage) advertised on site but no margin API documented â margin disabled.
min_order_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
max_risk_coef / collateral limits not documented â using defaults 3.0 / 10.0 / 100000.0
price_band_pct not documented â set 0 (no local price-band check)
qty_step not stated globally; per-pair base_precision/amount_step returned in pair metadata â using default 8
fee_pct 0.095 is starting tier for USDT markets; IRR markets start at 0.2%, tiered by monthly volume; interest_per_4h_pct not documented â default 0.05
docs.ramzinex.ir is JS-rendered; endpoint paths sourced from official Postman collection and ramzinex/php-sdk â verify at runtime
Private calls also require 'Authorization2: Bearer {token}' header; token derived from API key/secret and rotates every 10 min â derivation algorithm not documented
Candle array column order and pairs/state field names not fully verifiable from provided corpus
Markets identified by numeric pair_id (e.g. 272); lowercase url_name 'base-quote' used as symbol string
Candle from/to are unix seconds (TradingView-style resolution param), not milliseconds
Order placement/cancel endpoint paths absent from corpus â adapter limited to market data and paper trading
Leverage products exist on platform (easy/floating leverage, long/short) but margin API undocumented â margin disabled
min_order_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
min_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
max_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 100000.0
max_risk_coef not documented â using conservative default 3.0
price_band_pct not documented â set to 0 (no local check)
qty_step not documented globally; per-pair base_precision/price_step available via pairs endpoint â using default 8
Fees tiered maker/taker: USDT markets start 0.095%, IRR markets 0.2% â using 0.095 taker start
interest_per_4h_pct not documented â using conservative default 0.05
